ruleDefinitions.name: Schedule Task Creation From Env Variable Or Potentially Suspicious Path Via Schtasks.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Schtask creations that point to a suspicious folder or an environment variable often used by malware

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\All\\ Users\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Default\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%AppData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Public\\%.*"))) OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe\\ \\-k\\ netsvcs\\ \\-p\\ \\-s\\ Schedule$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%Public\\%.*")))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*unattended\\\.ini.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*update\\_task\\\.xml.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create\\ \\/TN\\ TVInstallRestore\\ \\/TR.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create\\ \\/Xml\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\\\\.CR\\\..*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Avira\\_Security\\_Installation\\\.xml.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create\\ \\/F\\ \\/TN.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Xml\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\is\\-.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Avira\\_.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\\\UpdateFallbackTask\\\.xml.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\\\WatchdogServiceControlManagerTimeout\\\.xml.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\\\SystrayAutostart\\\.xml.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tmp\\\\MaintenanceTask\\\.xml.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Create\\ \\/TN\\ \\"klcp\\_update\\"\\ \\/XML\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\klcp\\_update\\_task\\\.xml.*")))
